rules.statement: Where a person buys a lottery ticket in the name of another minor, no beneficial interest in the prize passes to the minor.
rules.supporting_quote: "As regards the intention of the appellant at the time of the purchase of the ticket it is obvious that a man in his position could not have had any intention to make a gift of such a sum to his son or even a gift of a chance of obtaining it. It is also clear that in purchasing the ticket he did not act under a mandate or in any sense as an agent for his son. By what process therefore did the beneficial interest pass to the son?"
